{{Quote|Family? We were ''never'' a family, "mother"&mdash;even ''before'' you took up with Veed. Dad&hellip; What did you ever see in such a nasty old ''rancor''?!|[[Gunn Yage]]|<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>}}
The '''Yage family''' was a notable family. [[Rulf Yage]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Fel Empire]], was a descendant of the family.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|348|Yage, Moff Rulf}}</ref>
